services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Our 33,000 square-foot facility is the perfect backdrop for groups of 20 to 2,000. Delight your guests with our truly one-of-a-kind atmosphere and award winning catering from Don Strange of Texas. From grilled white wings and steaks branded with your corporate logo to cakes that look just like a cactus, Don Strange of Texas, Inc. can handle all of your requests-and offer ideas you won't believe! With over 68 years of experience in catering, the Don Strange team will help you find the perfect location and do everything necessary to create a unique event. Whether entertaining 20 friends for a special occasion, 2,000 for a convention, planning a wedding or a company picnic, we will lead you
